notes.title: Update - New Advanced Mode Added
notes.content:
Hello everyone!  
This update mainly adds content that was originally planned before release but wasn’t finished in time.

Content Updates  
- The new Advanced Mode is now available. It will appear at the bottom right of the title screen after clearing the New Game+ mode.  
  Each time you complete a New Game run, a new tier will be unlocked.  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45363194/eab27e3c4388e24979d6edc90294c70257b36c00.jpg  
- The Blackjack tutorial will no longer repeat  
- New setting added for item font size

Bug Fixes  
- Fixed many known bugs

notes.title: Demo Update is Here!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I'm On.

The SWEEP-DEMO has been updated! If all goes well, this will be the final demo update before the official release.

New Additions in the Demo

 Added a triangle button that automatically selects the longest valid hand from your cards.
 Added a suit sorting option, so you can customize the card order to your preference.
 You can now apply a second sticker to a card.
 Improved the tutorial to make it clearer and more beginner-friendly.
 Added descriptions for items in the shop.
 

Changes & Adjustments

 Tweaked some item effects.
 Updated parts of the UI.
 Adjusted the player’s starting items.
 Rebalanced some enemy abilities to make battles more strategic.
 Changed how scissors and glue function.
 Fixed known bugs.


Thanks for your support!

notes.title: SWEEP has received a performance optimization!!
notes.content:
The game has received a performance optimization and should now run on most mainstream devices.

 Fixed a bug where pistol bullets sometimes became ineffective.

notes.title: The demo has been massively updated.
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

I’m On.

The SWEEP-DEMO has been updated, and the second floor of the dungeon is now open.

New Additions in the DEMO

 New starting deck - Joker Deck added.
 New starting item selection, including enhanced cards, Thompson submachine gun, and gas mask.
 Over ten new enemy types added.
 New DEBUFF - Poison Gas added.
 New BUFF - X2 added.
 Added chicken sound effects. (???)
 The frog merchant now sells more items.
 The second floor of the dungeon is now accessible.
 Graphics and game speed settings added.


Changes & Adjustments in the DEMO

 Playing Four of a Kind now grants BUFF - X2.
 The dungeon’s first-floor routes have been modified.
 Potion event effects adjusted.
 Gold Rush event item effects reworked.
 Removed the item “Shoulder Bag”.
 Adjusted the effects of some stickers.
 Removed inventory limits—players can now carry unlimited items.
 Increased prices in the frog shop.
 Added descriptions for items in the frog shop.
 A tutorial skip option is now available at the start of the game.
 Some bosses now obscure their own health bars.
 Enemy trait “Natural” now heals 30% HP instead of 10%.
 Insect-type boss trait changed to “Rage”.
 Optimized some controls (e.g., selected cards no longer reset after using a skill).
 Improved some visual effects.
 Fixed known bugs.
 Removed the Steam link from the start screen.


With this update, the DEMO should now offer a much more complete gameplay experience.
Hope you all enjoy playing!

Thank you!
